text:
```yaml
name: Pre-commit Autofix Trigger

on:
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [master]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  checks: read
  statuses: read
  contents: read

jobs:
  autofix-trigger:
    if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.type == 'Bot' || endsWith(github.actor, '[bot]') }}
    uses: shaypal5/pre-commit-ci-autofix-trigger/.github/workflows/autofix-trigger.yml@55d00aab
```
